About Us

Solutions tailored to the needs of our clients

Hotel TV Service

Learn More

Under a national DAS license, Catvision delivers a premium, app-based IPTV platform designed specifically for the hospitality industry.

Hospital TV Service

Learn More

Catvision’s IPTV platform is purpose-built for healthcare environments, delivering a blend of entertainment, patient engagement, and clinical support across ward rooms and public areas.

Channel Distribution

Learn More

We have over two decades of experience in the distribution in India of foreign satellite TV channels. Catvision helped launch CNN, MTV and Discovery in India. Currently, we partner with multiple international channels.

Optical Transmission

Learn More

Optical transceivers for EPON and GPON OLT, passive optical devices – couplers, splitters, patch cords and adaptors – and other accessories are stocked by Catvision to meet different customer needs.

Why Catvision?
